task.description: WF-02 step 8 item 4, UAT-RUNNER (role file .claude/agents/uat-runner.md): run the scenarios of docs/uat/REQ-113.md on a running system in a real Chrome, the way the run of REQ-111 (handoffs/M1CODE-20261119-01/step-08b-uat-runner-req111.json and docs/uat/REQ-111.md) did. Stand: make a FRESH clone of the local repo at commit b25c11e (app/ there is byte equal to the code that passed GitHub run 45001073839) with core.autocrlf=false into a scratch folder outside the project, npm ci there, start the app server on a free port (<APP>), and a second stand <APP-PUBLIC> made as the REQ-111 file says (the open public build, for V-20; if it cannot start, say so and mark V-20 'not run' with the reason). Real Chrome: the Chrome the project's e2e kit finds (headless allowed; if a visible Chrome is easy to start also take full-page screenshots there). Cells: FULL = 12 cells (3 windows x 2 themes x 2 languages) and CORE = 6 cells as each scenario says; kk is not run. Record for every scenario: PASS or FAIL, the measured observation, and the evidence file (screenshots into a folder outside the project, named in the record). Measure the numbers the scenarios ask for (first-screen top edge at 390x844, contrast, widths) rather than judge by eye, and look at the pictures yourself. Respect the request budget of the REQ-111 run: no more than the number of requests that run used, no load; GET and the page's own demo requests only; no real AI run (G2); no Vercel, no internet pages. READER PACK for R-01: from the stand, in ru at 390x844 and 1470x784, light, save for a reader that sees nothing else: (1) the visible text (innerText) of how.html, of the demo start page and of the demo result for the answers 'landing' (recommended) and for the no-match answers, in the order the visitor meets them, and full-page screenshots of these; (2) NO repository text, no file names, no requirement words, no hint of the key. Put it in a folder named reader-pack outside the project with a plain README that says only: 'This is a website of a service called Sai. Read it as a visitor and answer the three questions.' plus Part A of R-01 copied verbatim (the three questions) and nothing of Part B. Report the folder path. ORCH will give it to a separate reader and then score it with Part B (you do NOT score R-01 and you do NOT read the reader's answers). Classify every failure with severity and a fix wanted, and note what you could not run. Do NOT run npm run check, the app test scripts, node --test or the e2e tests (the owner's rule for this PC); npm ci in the scratch clone, starting the servers and driving Chrome with your own scripts are allowed. Stop only servers you started, by exact PID. Scratchpad <scratch> (own subfolder). Node 22 first on PATH (<node22>). No commit/push in the project. The record docs/uat/REQ-113-RUN.md is English; keep machine paths out of it (the traces check). Fill result; status stays PENDING; ORCH closes.

findings.text: `.r-sum + .r-lines` is false on a recommended result (the lists are appended after the block, the panel and the chips) and true on the no-match result; the guard test LD-6 asserts it only on no-match, also at the base commit. Criterion 3 says it still holds without naming the result. Proposal: BA-ANALYST says in the criterion text or the scenario that it is meant for the no-match result.

The scenario says that at the narrow windows the receipt and the lists come first and the block is above the panel. Built order at 390 and 320 on a recommended result: receipt, block, panel, answer chips, then the lists. The criterion (block above the panel, fixed list last) is met; the scenario sentence does not match what is built. Proposal: BA-ANALYST corrects the scenario text.
A press of the language button that is already current (English stored) does not add ?lang= to the address; a new profile starts Russian, so the scenario holds as written. Not in criterion 7.

The block on a recommended result starts at y 799 (320x568) and 763 (390x844) of the page, so it is below the first screen at 320x568 and just inside it at 390x844 (look 8.4, decisions/0126 O1). On how.html it starts at 550-557 px at the narrow windows, inside the first screen.
